title: Repair Local CI Environment Sensitivity and Validation Storage Hygiene

documentation_impact.rationale: Reviewed the governed documentation surfaces for CLI/API, configuration, architecture, operations, and contributor workflow. WI081 changes local validation internals and test fixtures without changing documented command behavior, supported configuration, or architecture. The existing local CI guide already documents immutable invocation evidence and fail-closed capture; the work-item README and validation report are lifecycle/evidence records, and the dashboard is generated. No additional product documentation update is required.

preflight.note: Operator previously directed that encountered pre-existing failures be repaired rather than waived. After WI080 PR21 local validation reported inherited CARGO_TARGET_DIR-induced Python test failures and a disk-exhausted output-capture attempt, this work item was opened before new implementation. Full PR21 evidence is preserved; successful subsequent rerun is not a waiver.

acceptance_criteria.text: Reproduce and diagnose the Python synthetic Cargo metadata test failures under inherited CARGO_TARGET_DIR, with exact tests, environment names (never secret values), fixture paths and source revision; distinguish test defect, runner defect and external host configuration. Preserve the original failed WI080 PR21 record.

Repair the confirmed CARGO_TARGET_DIR sensitivity in the relevant tests/fixtures or verifier using isolated environment/target paths and truthful Cargo metadata. Prove standard and non-default target locations pass without weakening assertions, excluding tests, or requiring global host environment mutation.

Measure and document host-local validation storage consumption, including Cargo target trees, Python environments, temporary candidate worktrees, reports and logs; establish a bounded local-run disk preflight and evidence retention policy suitable for low-storage hosts.

Implement and validate safe reclamation of exclusively tool-owned disposable builds and worktrees, preserving user changes, dirty checkouts, external caches, immutable evidence and reproducibility records. Cleanup must be dry-run/opt-in or tied to explicit owned manifests, with no arbitrary directory deletion or silent failures.

Handle disk exhaustion in local evidence/output capture with explicit failure and bounded diagnostics; preserve partial logs and completed evidence. Demonstrate the previous interrupted PR21 output-capture scenario cannot be silently misreported as a passed complete CI run.

Run focused regressions, complete Python suite, locked Rust workspace, canonical conformance and exact-head local verify ci both under the default environment and a controlled external CARGO_TARGET_DIR configuration; preserve failure evidence and record all required-step results.

Regenerate canonical semantic identity, governance/documentation mappings and dashboard as needed; pass canonical validate, frozen-surface verification and git diff --check without inventing green status for the historical Rust incident.

Reconcile cleanup ownership with any existing RepoPact Workbench/Fabric worktree-maintenance plans without broadening to unowned files; document independent review, actual code and evidence hashes, residual risks, and explicit operator integration decision. Maintain local-only CI through 2026-12-01 inclusive.
